correctness.rationale: Directly verified the self-similar Fourier product, mask antipodal-pair lemma, locally nonzero analytic tail, and nonzero pivot derivative. At most two scales vanish; cross-scale vanishing forces a two-line lower mask and a single-line upper mask with valuation2(p-q)=valuation2(r), leading to at most three transverse lines and Taylor order at most two. Exact 2-adic Haar probabilities yield all junction density 3/7 and triple density 1/7. Independent exact integer-congruence checker passed for all lattice points in centered cubes of radii 7, 15, 31; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The known mask-line and infinite-product descriptions are expressly attributed to Dutkay and Jorgensen. The present statement determines the full local singularity type/order, cross-scale arithmetic intersection criterion and density of junction strata. Searches and relevant full-text portions found no explicit equivalent or stronger incidence theorem. Same-measure Li (2012) remained abstract-only and older unindexed literature may cover an equivalent statement; independent priority audit has not been performed.

value.rationale: This complete classification identifies the singular strata of the real Fourier-orthogonality zero set of the canonical 3D tetrahedral gasket measure, sharply distinguishes linear-order two-line nodes from quadratic-order transverse triple junctions, and determines exact natural arithmetic densities 2/7 and 1/7. It supplies a reproducible whole-locus invariant, rather than a one-off numerical coincidence or rebranding of the mask formula.
